findings.observation: The adult band-3 face retains Elyn’s broad cheek planes, asymmetric brows, broad flat nose, defined cupid’s bow, freckles and restrained closed-mouth expression without a baby or generic doll-face replacement.
The narrow, healthy-slight, low-mass construction remains legible through a slim torso, modest shoulders, narrow hips and lightly built legs without generic body inflation.
Both upper arms, forearms, wrists and empty hands remain slim and source-relative; neither arm nor hand is made bulky merely for chibi scale.
The red-copper-auburn braids preserve the source scalp parting, close-braided right side, large offset left braid mass and long gathered silhouette.

The ochre-cream tailored cloth longcoat retains its readable waist, high soft collar, split and uneven layered hems, plain underlayer, fitted shoes, tally cord and small neck/nape marking without a new anchor.

Measured hair-top to chin against hair-top to lowest sole, the head-and-hair unit occupies approximately 30–31% of standing height, about 3.2–3.3 heads total; this is below the strict 32–36% band and the requested 34–35% aim.
Exactly one figure is present with the full hair silhouette, head, both empty hands, both legs, both fitted shoes, coat edges and grounding shadow inside generous margins.
The staggered planted feet, squared compact torso, separated empty hands and asymmetric braid-and-coat silhouette read as a grounded weaponless ready-idle at combat-icon scale.
The image remains an ordinary mortal textile presentation with no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, label, logo or watermark.
